name: Steven Scheppelman
headline: Founder, Extendro | NetSuite Architect | AI & Enterprise Automation | Former SDN Founder (Acquired)
about: I'm an extremely self-motivated learner. I want to transition from a consumer of cutting-edge tech, to become an innovator of bleeding-edge tech.

experiences.description:
At Extendro, LLC, I lead the development of innovative tools and solutions for the NetSuite ecosystem.

Extendro specializes in custom NetSuite integrations, performance optimization, and advanced development projects, helping organizations unlock the full potential of their ERP investment.

A key focus is building scalable products that enhance developer productivity and system visibility, including AI-driven tooling and modern interfaces that simplify complex workflows.

At RF-SMART, I joined as part of the acquisition of SummitIT, where I played a key role in integrating SummitIT’s technology and capabilities into the RF-SMART platform.

I led efforts to align systems, streamline product offerings, and ensure a smooth transition for customers and internal teams. Beyond integration, I designed and delivered new products and enhancements that generated additional annual recurring revenue (ARR).

I also developed internal tooling to enable faster, more consistent implementations, reducing friction for both customers and delivery teams. In addition, I introduced AI-assisted capabilities into the product to improve efficiency, usability, and overall customer experience.

My focus was on building scalable, high-impact solutions within the NetSuite ecosystem, driving both operational efficiency and revenue growth.
